body = cq.Workplane('YZ').circle(50).extrude(35)
hub = cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(35,0,0)).circle(16).extrude(12)
hub = hub.edges('>X').chamfer(0.7)
result = body.union(hub)
result = result.cut(cq.Workplane('YZ', origin=(-1,0,0)).circle(11).extrude(36))
